query: Create an internal link plan for our new pillar on real estate lead generation.
expected_behavior: Asks for a crawl export or site access and the list of related pages
Produces placements with source URL, sentence, descriptive anchor and canonical target
Links spokes to the pillar and pillar to spokes, capping new links per source page

query: Add our "best CRM" keyword as anchor text in the footer of every page.
expected_behavior: Advises against sitewide exact-match footer links as the main fix
Recommends varied, descriptive, in-context body links

query: Our product pages use JavaScript onclick buttons for navigation; is that fine for SEO?
expected_behavior: Explains Google reliably follows only <a> elements with href
Recommends crawlable <a href> links to canonical URLs
